info.name: DoorDash Drive Classic Addresses Quotes API

items.docs: Creates a delivery quote to confirm that a delivery is serviceable by DoorDash and returns the estimated fee and delivery time. Quotes are valid for 5 minutes after creation.

params.name: external_delivery_id
params.description: The unique external delivery ID provided when creating the delivery or quote.

items.docs: Accepts a previously created delivery quote and initiates the delivery process. The quote must be accepted within 5 minutes of being created. You can optionally edit the tip amount when accepting.
